title: Banana Words (Year 2-4)
source_note: 640 Tier-2 words for Aadiv (Year 2, starting Year 3 in 2027), written by Claude: level 1 = Year 2, 2 = Year 3, 3 = Year 4 stretch. Kid-friendly definitions, example sentences from a child's world, easy synonyms/opposites, memory hooks.

words.definition: empty inside, like a tube

words.hook: Say hello into a hollow log!

words.definition: flat and even, with no bumps

words.definition: very, very big

words.definition: something you win

words.definition: a cup or prize you get for winning
